generation_call_recovered: Not stored in the repository. heldout_generate.json was written by an inline load of this snapshot plus the adapter. The user text is user_task, a blank line, then tools_on_every_card. The prompt is apply_chat_template with add_generation_prompt=True and enable_thinking omitted. generate is called with max_tokens=180, verbose=False, and no sampler. The two saved write replies are 180 tokens, which matches that limit. The library default sampler, used when none is passed, is argmax.
top_p_note: make_sampler applies a nucleus filter only when 0 < top_p < 1. top_p 1.0 therefore leaves the full distribution, sampled at temperature 0.7.
